name: SlVisuallyHidden
description: Renders content assistive technology can reach but sighted users do not see. useSlVisuallyHidden owns the clip technique and focus-driven reveal; SlVisuallyHidden is the thin unstyled element. There is no themed wrapper. Hand-written until SLO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered root element. Choose the tag that is valid in the parent context. Interactive and void elements are excluded.

props.name: focusable
props.description: Reveals the content while focus is inside the subtree and hides it again when focus leaves. Required whenever the slot contains anything focusable, such as a skip link.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Content that must exist in the accessibility tree without a visual box. Keep it short; the text is announced in full.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The single rendered element selected by as.

states.name: hidden
states.description: Clip-technique hiding is applied. Omitted while focusable content is revealed.

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus to focusable descendants in document order. The component adds no key handling; with focusable, focusin reveals the content.
